channel.title: Parallax
channel.description: Same event, different vantage points. Geopolitical news compared across Western, Eastern, Middle Eastern and Russian outlets.

item.title: G7 nations agree to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel fuel.
item.description: On October 3, 2026, G7 nations agreed to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel from strategic reserves over four months in coordination with the International Energy Agency. While all regions confirm the volume and timeline, Western outlets frame the move as a strategic maneuver to preempt American protectionism and a specific threat of a Trump-led export ban. Conversely, Eastern and Russian sources frame the decision as a pragmatic success in global market stabilization and the removal of supply uncertainty.
